description: Creates a draft. It is NOT sent: the user reviews and sends it from Gmail. With reply_to_id it goes into that thread as a reply. attachments takes paths of local files (only from Downloads, Desktop or Documents, never hidden folders; up to 24 MB in total). Only attach files the user asked for.

account.description: Email address or label of the account (see list_accounts).

attachments.description: Paths of local files to attach (optional)

reply_to_id.description: ID of the email being answered (optional)

name: create_draft
